title: 210K/Hour Nether Portal Obsidian Farm
description:
Hope this new design will help you in your world.

210K/hour haven't been done before with a nether portal based farm so I hope this will inspire other farms.

World Download and Litmatica :
https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/10K_Z3abldgP5g0GjXsOMgtiHiwINWu0L?usp=drive_link

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Information to build the farm:

The portal cords need to be the same in X,Y and Z cords. 
Summon the wither on top of a stonecutter, a water source block on his head and an obsidian block behind him to block the vision of the wither and the opposite iron-golem).
Attack the withers once so that nothing is left of the 3x4 obsidian platform, it will break otherwise.
The nether part is just junk items, you can make a carpet duper…
You can use a ender pearl chunk loader to use the farm.
If portals spawn on the ground, make sure that no 3x4 flat area already exist. This will prevent new nether portal to randomly spawn on the ground of the farm
A cobblestone wall should be activated to prevent withers to lock in on the opposite wither when you stop the farm

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

!!! This farm can kill you or make your game lag if not built well !!!
